# General issue

Use the bug report template for defects or reproduction differences, and the
feature request template for new experiments or project ideas. For a general
question, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Describe the question or issue, what you expected, and any context that may
help reproduce or answer it.
